lumi-help.speaker: queen
lumi-help.text: My unicorn eggs need a Nest Keeper. Will you help me?

lumi-crown.speaker: queen
lumi-crown.text: Here is your crown. You are my Nest Keeper now!

lumi-welcome.speaker: queen
lumi-welcome.text: Welcome back, Nest Keeper! Your unicorns missed you.

lumi-egg-comes.speaker: queen
lumi-egg-comes.text: Here comes an egg. Ooh, it's cold!

lumi-two-eggs.speaker: queen
lumi-two-eggs.text: Two eggs tonight! A speckled egg, or a golden egg?

lumi-baby.speaker: queen
lumi-baby.text: A baby unicorn! Hello, little one.

lumi-off.speaker: queen
lumi-off.text: Off you go to the meadow!

lumi-new-baby.speaker: queen
lumi-new-baby.text: A new baby! Your family is growing.

lumi-sticker.speaker: queen
lumi-sticker.text: A new sticker for your Nest Book!

lumi-jar.speaker: queen
lumi-jar.text: The jar is full! A present from me.

lumi-bedtime.speaker: queen
lumi-bedtime.text: The moon is high. Bedtime, babies!

lumi-goodnight.speaker: queen
lumi-goodnight.text: Well done, Nest Keeper. Night night. See you tomorrow!
